cloudVC.description: cloudVC indicates if the vCenter is deployed on cloud.

controlPlaneCount.description: The value indicates the number of control planes enabled on the Supervisor.

cpuCount.description: The value indicates the number of CPUs available on the control plane VMs.

memoryMiB.description: The value indicates the amount of memory available on the control plane VMs.

cpVMSize.description: cpVMSize indicates the capacity of the Supervisor Control Plane. It's derived from Supervisor's tshirt size.

misconfiguredSoftwareChecksDryrunInterva.description: Duration after which the dry-run controller should be run again. Examples are '24h', '1d23h45m12s' etc. Defaults to 24h.

namespacesCLIPluginVersion.description: namespacesCLIPluginVersion indicates the Supervisor recommended namespaces CLIPlugin CR version.

networkProvider.description: networkProvider indicates the Network Provider used on Supervisor. (e.g. NSX or vsphere-network)

podVMSupported.description: podVMSupported indicates if the Supervisor supports PodVMs.

ssoDomain.description: ssoDomain indicates the name of the default SSO domain configured in vCenter.

stretchedSupervisor.description: This field indicates whether the environment is a Stretched Supervisor

tmcNamespace.description: tmcNamespace indicates the namespace used for TMC to be deployed.

vcPublicKeys.description: vcPublicKeys indicates the base64 encoded vCenter OIDC issuer, client audience and the public keys in JWKS format.
